comparison_method: Compared the actually displayed native, usage720 and thumbnail320 of repair-2 against previously actually viewed repair-1. No composite, crop or extra image created.

changes.observation: Title moved upward beside the now foreshortened grip. Lever tip shifted substantially right and no longer spans the full text-column width.
The strong crossing scratches are quieter; bright rounded rim and hole edge stand apart from center, though fine face mottling remains.
Guide groups moved upward and became slightly heavier while retaining all seven optical transcriptions and an unbroken address.
Continuous painted door, upper-left daylight and natural shadows remain; key and handle surface patterns changed beyond strict local preservation.

preserved_advantages: Same-door installed lever and cylinder/key-neck connection
Neutral everyday photographic mood and no extra labels

residuals.observation: A broad bright gripping strip is visible, but scattered fine pits and scratch marks remain across its surface.
